name: village-store-coins-build-only-v1
description: ⭐ THE FIRST OF THE TWO COIN BETS, ALONE: THE MINT PLUS THE BUILD SINK AND NOTHING ELSE. rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard 1 and rules.economy.coinSupplyPerPlayer 5 make the coin exist; rules.economy.coinPaysBuild and rules.economy.coinPaysSuitCost are true, so a coin pays any or all of a build cost including its n-of-suit requirement (V6) and Power and Endgame cards are included, two coins buying one (V7). rules.economy.coinPaysGrow and rules.economy.coinGrowOnFullBuilding are FALSE, so V8 and V9 are absent and this arm converts barn into TABLEAU only. ⛔ IT HAS TWO CONTROLS AND BOTH READINGS ARE WANTED. Against overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1.overlay.json it is the whole effect of the Build bet on the base game; against overlays/village-store-coins-v1.overlay.json, which differs from it in exactly the two Grow leaves, it is the Grow bet measured by subtraction. Its sibling is overlays/village-store-coins-grow-only-v1.overlay.json and the two together are the 05/09/2026 lesson applied before the fact: Build converts barn into tableau, Grow converts barn into repeatable abilities and deliberately suppresses harvesting, and IF THEY GO IN TOGETHER AND THE ARM READS BADLY NOBODY WILL KNOW WHICH DID IT. ⛔ C100 IS STILL OPEN AND NO NOTICE BOARD ARM IS RULED IN AS THE SHIPPED GAME: the shipped default is rules.turn.visitCurrency 'commons', so THIS IS AN ARM ON TOP OF AN ARM and every report header quoting it must say so. The seat-shaped host draw is only the best-performing configuration measured (5 PASS / 1 FAIL / 11 OBSERVE), not a ruling. ⛔ THIS IS ALSO THE BRANCHING RISK OF THE WHOLE PACKAGE AND THIS ARM IS WHERE IT SHOWS FIRST. Build payments are already C(hand, k), and coins add every split of j coins and k-j cards, so the count becomes a sum of binomials. ⭐ COINS ARE FUNGIBLE, SO THE ENUMERATOR MUST TREAT THE COIN COMPONENT AS A COUNT AND NEVER AS A CHOICE OF WHICH COINS. Run the branching bench before and after and quote BOTH move populations with seconds per game beside them (C99): a 116,535-move position stopped this project on 02/09/2026 and an 888,030-move one on 05/09/2026. ⭐ THE BUILDER DEFAULTS THIS ARM CARRIES, NAMED RATHER THAN DISCOVERED, because on 05/09/2026 an arm built for one purpose carried three unnamed knob changes and ruling it in ruled all four. Dean confirmed the indicated reading on all of D1 to D9 on 12/09/2026 and ruled D7 explicitly. D1: cards paid into the exchange go to the SUIT'S DISCARD and never out of the game, because returning stranded cards to circulation is Dean's own best argument for the Store. D2: ANY delivery mints, including one bought by a Notice Board power, not only a main-action Deliver. D3: declining to mint is EXPLICIT, so the turn settles cleanly. D4: an empty supply mid-conversion STOPS rather than refusing the whole exchange. D6: a coin does NOT count as a card for any card text that counts cards paid, the same family as the O17 fix. ⚠️ D5 HAS NO SUBJECT IN THIS ARM because there is no coin-Grow to fire an ability, and D7, D8 and D9 have no subject because there is no meeple. ⛔ WHAT MAY NOT BE QUOTED OFF THIS ARM. (1) THE BONUS RATE IS A SHARE OF TURNS AND NEVER PLAYS PER TURN; judging the band on plays cost this project a re-run of five arms on 09/09/2026. (2) NO LEVEL HERE IS COMPARABLE WITH A reference-v14 OR EARLIER NUMBER; only a delta paired on identical seeds against a named control is sound. (3) THE BARN GLUT READS +0.5 IDENTICALLY ACROSS THIS WHOLE FAMILY ON BYTE-IDENTICAL PER-SEAT LINES, so read the per-seat rows and NEVER the pooled median. (4) The hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S bound (C7) and the table plays with none, so nothing here is evidence about hand tightness in either direction. (5) ⛔ NOTHING ABOUT CLOG MAY BE READ OFF THIS ARM. The clog bypass is the Grow half and it is off here, so a flat barn-glut or Tier 3 reading is the absence of V9 rather than a finding about it. ⛔ C113, THE ARM'S OWN TEST. docs/village-store-2026-08-19-v1.md section 1 tested this exact rider-on-Deliver placement and ruled it out: 'Free / a rider on Deliver. No cost, so it is always correct. Breaks everything.' Dean's answer of 12/09/2026 is that a valid delivery is a precondition and the capped supply bounds the reward. THE CORE OBJECTION STANDS AS A TEST: if every player converts every spare card every time, the August verdict was right and THE PLACEMENT IS WHAT TO CHANGE. ⭐ AND THE READING THIS ARM OWNS IS OWN-CROP BUILD SHARE against its standing 83% (82.6% before v31, 83.3% after), because rules.economy.coinPaysSuitCost is the first thing anybody has proposed that makes off-crop building and off-suit Powers cheap. Read buildings built by crop beside it, and the win rate gap of Orchard 17.4% against Wheat 41.9%. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME. THIRTY LEAVES. The control's twenty, unchanged and in its own order: rules.turn.visitCurrency, bonusTiming, selfVisitAllowed, hostDrawOnVisit, commonsTake, startingMeeplesPerColour, meepleAsCard, slotToll, meepleCapPerColour; rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold, noticeBoardBlocks, unclaimedBoardsToCentre, noticeBoardsBySeats.2, .3 and .4, commonsColourMatch, commonsWildPair, endgameCoinCost, farmsteadCoinPower; and rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisitBySeats.4. ⛔ TWO OF THOSE ARE COIN LEAVES AND THEY STAY OFF ON PURPOSE: rules.economy.endgameCoinCost null and rules.economy.farmsteadCoinPower false belong to the separate commons-with-coins arm of 10/09/2026 and are a second mint and a second sink. Keeping them off is what makes rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard the only faucet, and every coin economy this project has had died of a second faucet or a pity rate. Then the six coin leaves, four on and two off as above, and the four meeple leaves pinned at their shipped values so the delivery meeple cannot ride in: rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace null (which means defer to the existing meeplesPerTile seeding and NOT 'no meeples'), meepleSpendTiming 'start' (the shipped value; 'none' would delete a phase a named control replays against), meepleSpendPerTurn null (unlimited, and 0 would delete the phase) and meepleSpendDistinctColours false. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired on identical seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. ⚠️ AS OF COMMIT e5aea08 ALL TEN NEW LEAVES ARE INERT: they exist in the data layer and no branch of play reads them yet, so this arm currently measures identically to its control. A run before the engine slices land proves the file parses and validates, and nothing else. ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved.
